_about: Default settings for new assignments made with 'New from documents'. The assignment's own pack.json, inside its workspace, is what grading uses.

level_descriptions.75: Mostly correct; one important part is missing or wrong.
level_descriptions.50: Main idea is present, but several important parts are missing or wrong.
level_descriptions.25: Only limited correct work is shown.
level_descriptions.0: Missing, unrelated, or no usable work.

categories.label: Results or checks not produced by the submitted work
categories.description: Reported numerical results or verification values that the submitted code, its shown output, or the AI record do not produce.
categories.student_text: Some reported results or verification values could not be traced to the code, output or AI record you submitted.
categories.ta_check: Look for the reported values in the code (Appendix B) and in any output shown in the AI record. Confirm only if they are not produced there.

categories.label: AI record incomplete or summarized
categories.description: Responses replaced by descriptions, conversations cut off, a task's conversation missing, or evidence of an AI conversation that was not included.
categories.student_text: The AI interaction record was not complete. The assignment required the full chronological record, including all responses.
categories.ta_check: Open the AI record and check whether responses are replaced by descriptions, cut off, or whether a task's conversation is missing.

categories.label: Claimed process not supported by the AI record
categories.description: The report describes a correction, check or step that does not appear in the submitted AI record or code.
categories.student_text: The report describes work (for example a correction or check) that does not appear in your submitted AI record or code.
categories.ta_check: Find the step or correction the report describes, then look for it in the AI record and the code.

categories.label: AI record missing
categories.description: No AI interaction record was submitted at all.
categories.student_text: No AI interaction record was submitted. The assignment required the complete record in Appendix A.
categories.ta_check: Check the end of the PDF for any AI conversation, under any heading. Confirm if there is none.

categories.label: AI record given only as a link
categories.description: A share link was given instead of the AI conversation itself in the PDF.
categories.student_text: The AI record was given only as a link. The assignment required the complete conversation in the PDF.
categories.ta_check: Check that the PDF holds only a link and not the conversation. You may open the link, but it is not required.

categories.label: AI record submitted as images
categories.description: The AI record was given as screenshots, scans or printed pages instead of selectable text.
categories.student_text: The AI record was submitted as images. It had to be selectable text.
categories.ta_check: Scroll through the AI record pages. Confirm if the conversation is pictures (screenshots, printed pages) rather than selectable text.

categories.label: Code submitted as images
categories.description: The code was given as screenshots, scans or printed pages instead of selectable text.
categories.student_text: The code was submitted as images. It had to be selectable text.
categories.ta_check: Scroll to the code. Confirm if it is a picture rather than selectable text.

categories.label: Report text submitted as images
categories.description: Report pages given as images instead of selectable text. Handwritten derivations are allowed as images and are not a violation.
categories.student_text: Parts of the report were submitted as images. Only handwritten derivations may be images.
categories.ta_check: Look at the listed report pages. Reject if they are handwritten derivations, which are allowed. Confirm if typed text was pasted as an image.

categories.label: Other integrity concern
categories.description: Any other concrete concern the TA wants the instructor to see.
categories.student_text: An integrity concern was noted by the grader.
categories.ta_check: Read the note and decide whether it is a real problem.
